newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens sees steel caster on stream by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens sees steel caster on stream by 2000.

text.p: Hoogovens NV said on Thursday it expected a new "thin slab caster" for its steel works to be in full production by the year 2000.

Hoogovens steel chief Ad van der Velden told a news conference that Hoogovens expected to give the go-ahead this year for the project which will require an investment of 500 million guilders spread over several years.
The thin slab caster will integrate the processes of continuous casting and hot-rolling which are completely separate under the conventional method of producing steel strip.
Van der Velden said the new facility will complement the existing hot-rolling mill at Hoogovens' IJmuiden works.
It will have an annual capacity of 1.5 million tonnes, of which about one million will represent an expansion of capacity.
Van der Velden said the investment was part of a continuing drive by Hoogovens to lower its costs by embracing technology which eliminated whole steps in the production process.
Hoogovens also plans to invest in a cyclone converter furnace (CFC) which will allow crude steel to be produced without some of the inputs traditionally used.
